messages:
alex_support: FYI customer reported logins failing after their IdP cert rotation, started ~08:20 UTC. They see 403/InvalidRecipient errors in our logs.

alex_support: Sample error from our edge: `saml: assertion recipient mismatch: expected https://app.redwood.io/sso/acs, got https://app.redwood.io/sso/acs/` — note the trailing slash.

devon_oncall: Can we get the full SAMLResponse (redacted) and the IdP metadata URL? Need to confirm signing cert thumbprint and any dual-key descriptors.

alex_support: Pasted minimal redacted response and metadata link in a secure paste, DMing. Also saw `Signature didn't verify with any trusted cert` around the same time.

sophie_idp: @alex_support I pulled the metadata endpoint they gave: https://idp.acme-corp.com/.well-known/saml/meta.xml — looks like they rotated to a new signing key this morning but left the old key in the metadata under a separate KeyDescriptor. The order changed.

devon_oncall: Order shouldn't matter, but older cert might be still served by IDP until their CDN flushes. Two problems that would cause 403: (1) signature verification fails because we only cached new metadata that references the new cert, but SAMLResponse signed with old cert; (2) recipient/audience mismatch bc trailing slash normalization.

alex_support: Repro steps I used: 1) Trigger login via /login?sso=true 2) IdP redirects to our ACS with SAMLResponse 3) Edge validates signature and recipient. curl logs attached.

saml_bot: Metadata refresh worker ran at 07:14 UTC and updated cached keys for tenant=acme. Last-fetched-thumbprint=AB:CD:EF:12:34:56. Cached-ttl=300s.

sophie_idp: They did a rolling rotation: new cert active at 07:10, old cert served from origin until 08:15 due to CDN. If our cache refreshed at 07:14 we likely have new cert in trust store while IdP still signed with old cert for a short window.

devon_oncall: Short-term mitigation: temporarily accept both thumbprints for that tenant (server-side allowlist) while CDN flush completes. I'll spin up an A/B config to accept thumbprint AB:CD:EF... + 98:76:54... for 1 hour.

alex_support: Customer asked if this is an ongoing bug — they're worried about future rotations. Recommended: support dual-key rotation and increase metadata fetch frequency during planned rotations.

sophie_idp: Also noticed ACS mismatch: their ACS url in metadata is `https://app.redwood.io/sso/acs` but IdP sends redirect to `https://app.redwood.io/sso/acs/` (trailing slash). We should canonicalize recipients or accept both variants.

devon_oncall: I'll add tolerant recipient check for trailing slash on the tenant for now. Long term: normalizing URLs in our SAML layer and emitting a warning in console when an ACS URL mismatch is detected.

alex_support: Created internal ticket REDWOOD-6543 and flagged for severity=P2. Notified customer and asked them to retry in 15m after our temporary changes.

saml_bot: Deployment note: canary change to accept dual-thumbprints applied to 2 machines at 08:36 UTC. Recipient-tolerance change scheduled for 08:50 UTC canary.

alex_support: Customer confirmed at 08:49 UTC that login flows are back to normal. They will coordinate with their CDN team to ensure next rotation includes both keys in metadata and shorter cache TTL. :thumbsup:

devon_oncall: Follow-ups: 1) Add docs blurb about dual-key rotation best practices, 2) extend metadata-refresh instrumentation, 3) track how often rotations cause transient failures.

sophie_idp: I updated our internal KB with a checklist for customers: include old cert for N hours, verify metadata URL returns both keys, and pre-notify Redwood support when rotating.

alex_support: Closing thread — leaving REDWOOD-6543 open for doc + code follow-ups. Thanks all.
